package filters

const (
	DefaultPage  = 1
	DefaultLimit = 20
	MinPage      = 1
	MaxPage      = 100
	MinLimit     = 10
	MaxLimit     = 100
)

// NormalizePagination returns validated page, limit, and offset values.
func NormalizePagination(pageValue *int, limitValue *int) (int, int, int) {
	page := DefaultPage
	if pageValue != nil {
		page = *pageValue
	}
	limit := DefaultLimit
	if limitValue != nil {
		limit = *limitValue
	}
	if page < 1 {
		page = DefaultPage
	}
	if page > MaxPage {
		page = MaxPage
	}
	if limit < MinLimit || limit > MaxLimit {
		limit = DefaultLimit
	}
	offset := (page - 1) * limit
	return page, limit, offset
}
